senses.gloss: saukarika (acc. to BR in Skt. only boar-hunter, and so AMg. soyariya acc. to Ratnach., but, acc. to Sheth, AMg. and other Pkt. soaria also butcher; the distinction was probably hardly made in India; from sūkara plus ika; Pali only sūkarika), pork-butcher: Mvy 〔3760〕 = Tib. phag (ḥ)tshoṅ ba, seller of, dealer in pork; Divy 〔505.4, 11, 25〕; Bbh 〔302.9〕.
